answer: Yes, you can sell us a car you still owe money on. While the loan is open, your lender holds the title (or the electronic title record), so you don't need the title in hand. At the appointment we confirm what you owe and pay the lender off directly from your offer, and if the offer is more than the payoff, you get the difference. To speed things up, get a payoff letter from your lender before you come in.
